content:
**Aristocracy** comes in many forms in *[World of Warcraft](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/World_of_Warcraft)*. The following list of [aristocrats](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Aristocrat) may be useful for planning assassinations ([PvE](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/PvE)), marriages ([RP](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/RP)), or pointedly ignoring ([PvP](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/PvP)). This list includes RPG characters and discretion is advised. Characters with multiple titles are only displayed to their highest rank.

## Emperor/Empress

- *"Emperor" redirects here. For the brew made by [Chen Stormstout](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Chen_Stormstout), see ["The Emperor"](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/%22The_Emperor%22).*

### Beast

- [Hai'shulud](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Hai%27shulud) — The Bone Emperor †

### Dwarf

- [Sorcerer-Thane Thaurissan](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Sorcerer-Thane_Thaurissan) — Former Emperor of the [Dark Iron dwarves](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Dark_Iron_dwarf) †
- [Empress Zoe](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Empress_Zoe) — Former Empress of the [Dark Iron dwarves](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Dark_Iron_dwarf) †
- [Empress Modgud](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Modgud) — Former Empress of the [Dark Iron dwarves](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Dark_Iron_dwarf) †
- [Emperor Dagran Thaurissan](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Dagran_Thaurissan) — Former Emperor of the [Dark Iron dwarves](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Dark_Iron_dwarf) †
- [Empress Moira Thaurissan](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Moira_Thaurissan) — Empress-Regent of the [Dark Iron clan](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Dark_Iron_clan) and (legally) Queen of [Ironforge](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Ironforge).

### Hozen

- [Emperor Rikktik](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Emperor_Rikktik) — Hozen Emperor †

### Jinyu

- [Emperor Rassharom](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Emperor_Rassharom) — Ancient Emperor of [Pandaria](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Pandaria) †

### Ogre

- [Imperator Gorgog the Gronnslayer](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Gorgog_the_Gronnslayer) — Founder of the [Gorian Empire](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Gorian_Empire) †
- [Imperator Mar'gok](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Imperator_Mar%27gok) — Last sorcerer king of the Gorian Empire †
  - [Imperator Mar'gok](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Imperator_Mar%27gok_(alternate_universe)) — Sorcerer king of the Gorian Empire †
- [Imperator Molok](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Imperator_Molok) — Sorcerer king of the Gorian Empire †

### Mantid

- [Grand Empress Shek'zeer](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Grand_Empress_Shek%27zeer) — Empress of the [mantid](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Mantid) †
- [Grand Empress Zek'hara](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Grand_Empress_Zek%27hara) — Former Empress of the [mantid](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Mantid) †

### Mogu

- [Emperor Dojan Firecrown](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Dojan_Firecrown) — Emperor of the [mogu empire](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Mogu_empire) †
- [Emperor Dojan II](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Emperor_Dojan_II) — Emperor of the [mogu empire](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Mogu_empire) †
- [Emperor Kang](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Emperor_Kang) — Emperor of the [mogu empire](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Mogu_empire) †
- [Emperor Lao-Fe](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Spirit_of_Lao-Fe) — Emperor of the [mogu empire](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Mogu_empire) †
- [Emperor Lei Shen](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Lei_Shen) — First Emperor of the [mogu empire](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Mogu_empire) †
- [Emperor Wai](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Emperor_Wai) — Emperor of the [mogu empire](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Mogu_empire) †

### Naga

- [Queen Azshara](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Queen_Azshara) — Empress of [Nazjatar](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Nazjatar_Empire) and queen of the [naga](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Naga)
- [Raj Naz'jan](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Raj_Naz%27jan) — Deceased Emperor of the Riplash Strand †

### Pandaren

- [Emperor Ku](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Emperor_Ku) — Emperor of the [Pandaren Empire](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Pandaren_Empire) †

### Sethrak

- [Emperor Korthek](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Emperor_Korthek) — Emperor of the Faithless †

### Qiraji

- [Emperor Vek'lor](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Emperor_Vek%27lor) — Co-ruler of the Qiraji †
- [Emperor Vek'nilash](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Emperor_Vek%27nilash) — Co-ruler of the Qiraji †

### Tol'vir

- [Emperor Ninjter](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Emperor_Ninjter) — Deceased Emperor of Ramkahen †

### Troll

- [Emperor Var'gazul](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Var%27gazul) — Last Emperor of the [Gurubashi Empire](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Gurubashi_Empire) †

- [Talon King Ikiss](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Talon_King_Ikiss) — Self-proclaimed [Terokk](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Terokk) reborn, king of [Skettis](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Skettis) †

# Countess Ashmore

| Countess Ashmore | |
|---|---|
| | |
| Gender | Female |
| Race | [Blue dragon](/wiki/Blue_dragon) |
| Location | [Witchwood](/wiki/Blackwald), [Gilneas](/wiki/Gilneas_peninsula) |
“1 minion... ah, ah, ah! 2 minions... ah, ah, ah! 3 minions... ah, ah, ah!”

- — Flavor text

**Countess Ashmore** is a [blue dragon](/wiki/Blue_dragon)[1] featured in the *[The Witchwood](/wiki/Hearthstone:_The_Witchwood)* expansion for *[Hearthstone](/wiki/Hearthstone_(game))*.

The countess is an enigma, and no one in [Gilneas](/wiki/Gilneas_peninsula) seems to have heard of her noble line prior to the Witchwood curse, but suddenly, the records show an Ashmore family tree stretching all the way back to pre-[Alliance](/wiki/Alliance_of_Lordaeron) days, written in a hand none of the royal scribes recognize. She's taken up residence in an old manor that's been abandoned since before the first battle of Gilneas, but while some claim that many voices can be heard emerging from the old estate, she's the only one who's been seen entering or leaving. It's rumored that Ashmore is researching the curse, and she has been asking questions of those who claim to have witnessed dragons in the wood. It is not clear if Ashmore is truly the scion of a forgotten noble family returned home in a time of need, or if she is something much more dangerous.[2]
